summary: ReserveAmerica confirms the 2027 season May 28-Oct 10 with a possible mid-May opening (unchanged), reservable (booking was only inherited; now verified). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, 50 A (every site electric: 23 x 30 A, 23 x 50 A), 46 sites to 50 ft (back-in), showers, dump. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. RA describes the campground as 'adjacent to the beach, with an excellent view of the water', consistent with lakeview. Note unchanged.
